summary:
Scope: maintained source contract for BAR issue1032, not native qualification or invocation authority. The fixed dispatch-only hosted route distinguishes network-prerequisite/metadata-only from full-image purpose. Both require a fresh VM/boot/operation/stores, clean complete internal source histories, pinned helper/product bytes and strict source identity. The fixed checkout bootstrap validates checkout-created singleton local gc.auto0, removes only that key and verifies other configuration bytes unchanged. Root selects each original separately; no retry, resume, previous-store replay or partial-stage completion closes the full image promise.

The resource/time contract remains four CPU affinity,14GiB available memory,80GiB free store headroom and4096 delegated tasks,90-minute outer job and3600+120-second managed controller clock. The tiny fixed prerequisite RUN has a nested120-second cap and exact-base pull600seconds, consuming that original work clock. BAR explicitly refreshes canonical resource admission after pull and immediately before the new build; sampled usage ceilings do not prove free-headroom floors or make a new label inherit the shared dispatch allowlist. Full generation repeats the prerequisite on its own fresh VM, then owes the complete pinned toolchain/Recoil headers and engine archive/HighBar stock plugin and compiled controls/BAR Rapid game graph/map, static ELF correspondence, image identity/export and separate-store load/readback.

The original15 support roles remain mandatory. Network selection binds fixed pasta aliases, both passt/AVX2 objects and actual loader/library/cache closure before the private network/PID/IPC, rootless, no-new-privileges RUN. Preserve the backend, original helper paths, flags and host policy; no host-network, privilege or policy bypass is a repair. Root-produced proc/namespace/credential/LSM observations retain Unknowns. Rootless Podman AppArmor support=false, an empty audit log or an unreadable observation does not prove host LSM absence. A netns permission refusal identifies the failed interface, not its sole kernel/LSM denier. Source review and pure ports do not establish native prerequisite success or external egress.

Optional privileged diagnostics stage outside canonical primary evidence and share the existing9-minute receipt aperture, including a nested30-second kernel read. Always attempt primary receipt; failed, partial, unreadable, malformed or oversized optional data becomes bounded secondary Unknown without discarding original first cause/raw-stream transport. Validate the intended finite canonical representation inside the optional failure boundary: valid JSON1e999 parses as inf without invoking parse_constant, so rejecting NaN alone is insufficient. Matching-current-boot/exit0 overflow must still preserve primary staging; metadata success cannot manufacture successful qualification or a BAR candidate.

Only a verified full candidate can enter CMS AuthEnvelopedData AES256GCM plus RSAOAEP SHA256/MGF1SHA256 encryption. Streaming uses BER despite the DER CLI option. Public artifacts contain ciphertext and bounded nonsecret metadata; the public recipient and actual OpenSSL/loader/library identities bind to one original deadline, while the private key remains operator-only. Private independent decrypt/digest/OCI readback needs separate admission. The failed original attempts remain failed. Direct-child EOF/reaping does not establish whole-descendant settlement or physical provider disposal; those Unknowns, historical holds and resource ownership remain separate. Full image acceptance, loaded ABI, useful gameplay, B2 adoption and publication retain their own obligations. Pure semantic success and conformity to an admitted wall horizon are separate findings; retain actual overruns and size focused checks from observed costs.
title: Hosted BAR image source contract and encrypted candidate custody
